boundaries.name: field-products-and-representatives
boundaries.obligation: FieldProducts (x*y = 0 mod p implies a zero factor) and the Centered/Canonical representative convention are hypotheses of every gate-to-integer lemma; derive them from Goldilocks primality and actual wire values instead of assuming them.

boundaries.name: plonky2-gate-and-range-check-lowering
boundaries.obligation: Show that builder.range_check, add_virtual_bool_target_safe, is_equal/and/assert_zero, mul/add/sub/connect and the constant targets lower to the RangeGate/Bool/FZero predicates the model uses; no split_le or compiler refinement is proved.

boundaries.name: hash-digest-binding
boundaries.obligation: keccak256 and Poseidon are explicit HashRequests over exact word streams; collision resistance, the Bytes32 output encodings, and that equal digests imply equal (a, b, c1, c2) are not proved, nor is the caller connect to the committed H1/ciphertext digests.

boundaries.name: native-machine-refinement
boundaries.obligation: Refine the Int/Nat native model to Rust i64/i32/u128/u64/u32/u16/u8 arithmetic, casts, indexing, debug_assert, unwrap and the imported encode_amount; NativeMachineDomain only records the widths.

boundaries.name: decryption-oracle-soundness-and-key-uniqueness
boundaries.obligation: The gates are modular equations; no proof that a satisfying (s, v, d) equals the plaintext produced by the upstream decrypt rounding (upstreamDigit is deliberately unrelated), that the ternary s satisfying key binding is unique, or that the noise budget makes the decoded digits the encrypted amount.

boundaries.name: ciphertext-authenticity-and-recipient-entitlement
boundaries.obligation: The gadget receives a, b, c1, c2 as witnessed targets; that they are the committed public key and ciphertext of the entitled recipient, and that the exposed amount limbs are connected to the claim public input, are caller obligations outside this file.

boundaries.name: rust-source-and-circuit-refinement
boundaries.obligation: No certificate links decryption_core, the native builder or fill_decryption_core as compiled Rust/plonky2 to the Lean definitions; the model is a handwritten restatement and the build-phase order is asserted, not extracted.
